name: architecture-cartographer
description: Architecture Cartographer CLI surface. Schema-validated against cli-manifest/v1 and cross-validated against the per-domain Connect-RPC proto descriptors at test time. Loaded by cli/main.go via cliapp.LoadFromManifest.

groups.name: domains
groups.description: Derive a scenario's intended domain map from its on-disk sources (zero-config)

commands.name: extract
commands.description: Derive the domain map for a scenario from the extraction ladder

commands.name: show
commands.description: Show the derived domain map for a scenario

commands.name: convergence
commands.description: Report where a scenario's surfaces disagree on the domain set (advisory)

commands.name: draft
commands.description: Print a proposed DOMAINS.md inventory from extracted evidence without writing it

groups.name: graph
groups.description: Extract architecture graphs by composing language code-graph adapters

commands.name: extract
commands.description: Extract a normalized cross-language graph for a target scenario

flags.name: idempotency-key
flags.description: Idempotency-Key passthrough for caller-controlled dedupe

commands.name: retention-preview
commands.description: Preview reclaimable snapshot storage beyond the retention floor

flags.name: keep
flags.description: Override the retention floor for this preview only

commands.name: retention-apply
commands.description: Prune snapshots beyond the retention floor and return freed pages to the filesystem

flags.name: keep
flags.description: Override the retention floor for this prune only

flags.name: confirm
flags.description: Required: applying retention permanently deletes snapshots

groups.name: zones
groups.description: Inspect template-derived code-layout zones and layering cross-checks

commands.name: show
commands.description: Show the package-to-zone map for a target scenario

flags.name: snapshot-id
flags.description: Optional graph snapshot id; defaults to the latest cached snapshot or a fresh extraction

groups.name: slice
groups.description: Inspect a domain's proto-to-surface implementation slice

commands.name: show
commands.description: Show the implementation slice for a target scenario domain

flags.name: snapshot-id
flags.description: Optional graph snapshot id; defaults to the latest cached snapshot or a fresh extraction

groups.name: archetype
groups.description: Infer and converge each domain's archetype (Q20) against the declared DOMAINS.md value

commands.name: infer
commands.description: Infer each domain's archetype from graph signals and report declared-vs-inferred drift

flags.name: domain
flags.description: Optional single domain; defaults to every domain in the map

flags.name: snapshot-id
flags.description: Optional graph snapshot id; defaults to the latest cached snapshot or a fresh extraction

groups.name: audit
groups.description: Run a CI-shaped drift audit — orchestrates graph extract (if needed), domains derivation, and conflicts detection, then maps the outcome to a process exit code

commands.name: run
commands.description: Audit a scenario for architectural drift and exit 0 (clean) / 1 (findings ≥ threshold) / 2 (tool error) / 3 (usage error)

flags.name: fail-on
flags.description: Minimum severity that flips outcome to FINDINGS: info | warn (default) | error | blocker

flags.name: include-types
flags.description: Comma-separated whitelist of conflict types to include

flags.name: exclude-types
flags.description: Comma-separated blacklist of conflict types to exclude

flags.name: allow-low-authority
flags.description: Treat low/missing authority confidence (no curated DOMAINS.md) as clean; default fails the audit

flags.name: skip-ts
flags.description: Skip the TypeScript analysis layer; outcome becomes PARTIAL when TS was the only thing skipped (Go findings still drive outcome)

commands.name: run-all
commands.description: Sweep every discoverable scenario and aggregate the audit reports

flags.name: fail-on
flags.description: Per-scenario severity threshold (info | warn | error | blocker)

flags.name: include-types
flags.description: Comma-separated whitelist of conflict types

flags.name: exclude-types
flags.description: Comma-separated blacklist of conflict types

flags.name: include-scenarios
flags.description: Comma-separated whitelist of scenario names

flags.name: exclude-scenarios
flags.description: Comma-separated blacklist of scenario names

flags.name: concurrency
flags.description: Worker pool size (default 4)

flags.name: allow-low-authority
flags.description: Treat low authority confidence as clean for every scenario in the sweep

flags.name: allow-low-authority-scenarios
flags.description: Comma-separated scenarios for which low/missing authority is treated as clean (per-scenario opt-out; ORed with --allow-low-authority)

groups.name: conflicts
groups.description: Detect, triage, and resolve architecture-drift conflicts — the agent-facing conflict workbench

commands.name: detect
commands.description: Run every registered Detector against a scenario's snapshot + manifest, persist, and list the conflicts

flags.name: snapshot-id
flags.description: Detect against a specific snapshot id (default: extract a fresh one)

flags.name: idempotency-key
flags.description: Idempotency-Key passthrough for caller-controlled dedupe

commands.name: list
commands.description: List persisted conflicts for a scenario, filterable by type

flags.name: type
flags.description: Comma-separated conflict-type filter

flags.name: page-size
flags.description: Maximum conflicts to return

flags.name: page-token
flags.description: Pagination cursor from a prior response

commands.name: show
commands.description: Show one persisted conflict with evidence and suggested fixes

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Re-run detection against the current resolution state and report cartographer-clean closure

commands.name: detectors
commands.description: List the registered Detector plug-ins

commands.name: resolvers
commands.description: List the registered Resolver plug-ins

groups.name: signals
groups.description: Score chunks, explain aggregator verdicts, and inspect the signal registry

commands.name: score
commands.description: Run every enabled Signal against a file's chunk and show the aggregated verdict

positionals.name: file
positionals.description: File to score: either a snapshot file id (e.g. "file:api/...") or a repo-relative path (e.g. "api/internal/graph/service.go")

commands.name: explain
commands.description: Explain a verdict with the full per-signal evidence breakdown

positionals.name: file
positionals.description: File to explain: either a snapshot file id or a repo-relative path

commands.name: list
commands.description: List registered Signals with default weights and enable/disable state

flags.name: scenario
flags.description: Reflect manifest-overlaid weights for this scenario

commands.name: boundaries
commands.description: Show per-domain coupling/boundary-health scores (advisory)

groups.name: analytics
groups.description: Inspect the append-only analytics log, stats roll-up, placements, and operator overrides

commands.name: events
commands.description: Page the append-only analytics event log for a scenario

flags.name: kind
flags.description: Comma-separated EventKind filter (e.g. conflict_detected,override_recorded)

flags.name: since
flags.description: RFC3339 cutoff; only events at or after this time

flags.name: page-size
flags.description: Maximum events to return

flags.name: page-token
flags.description: Pagination cursor from a prior response

commands.name: stats
commands.description: Show the analytics roll-up (verdict-success rate suppressed below the N>=5 threshold)

commands.name: placements
commands.description: List placement-outcome rows for a scenario

flags.name: outcome
flags.description: Comma-separated outcome filter (auto_placed,suggested,overridden,rejected)

flags.name: page-size
flags.description: Maximum placements to return

flags.name: page-token
flags.description: Pagination cursor from a prior response

commands.name: override-record
commands.description: Record an operator override of a verdict

flags.name: chunk-id
flags.description: Chunk the override applies to

flags.name: verdict-domain
flags.description: Domain the aggregator recommended

flags.name: chosen-domain
flags.description: Domain the operator chose instead

flags.name: note
flags.description: Operator note

flags.name: verdict-event-id
flags.description: Pointer to the original verdict_produced event

flags.name: idempotency-key
flags.description: Idempotency-Key passthrough for caller-controlled dedupe

groups.name: apply
groups.description: Plan and (in a later phase) execute per-domain conflict resolutions. v0.1 plans only; `apply run` is unimplemented.

commands.name: plan
commands.description: Deterministically derive the operation list that would resolve a domain's conflicts (v0.1: read-only, no toolchain)

flags.name: conflict-id
flags.description: Comma-separated conflict ids to plan for (default: every conflict assigned to the domain)

commands.name: run
commands.description: Execute a planned apply. v0.1 always returns a capability-not-available message (execution lands in the apply-execution plan).

flags.name: acknowledge
flags.description: Acknowledge that v0.1 RunApply is unimplemented (reserved for the v0.2 opt-in)

commands.name: history
commands.description: List apply runs for a scenario (empty in v0.1)

flags.name: domain
flags.description: Filter to one domain

flags.name: page-size
flags.description: Maximum runs to return

flags.name: page-token
flags.description: Pagination cursor from a prior response

commands.name: baseline
commands.description: Show the toolchain build baseline (empty in v0.1; BuildGuard is unwired)

commands.name: suppress
commands.description: Write an in-repo // arch:allow marker sanctioning a finding as intentional

flags.name: reason
flags.description: Why this finding is intentional (mandatory)

flags.name: expires
flags.description: Optional expiry, e.g. until:2026-12-31

flags.name: line
flags.description: Optional 1-based insertion line (default: end of file)

groups.name: campaign
groups.description: Track a scenario-improvement effort — ingest a test-genie audit, work the profile-ranked worklist, reconcile re-audits by stable id

commands.name: create
commands.description: Open a campaign for a scenario and ingest findings from a test-genie audit report

flags.name: name
flags.description: Human label for the campaign

flags.name: from-audit
flags.description: Path to a test-genie --json SuiteExecutionResult (or - for stdin) whose findings are ingested

commands.name: list
commands.description: List a scenario's campaigns (newest first), or every campaign when --scenario is omitted

flags.name: scenario
flags.description: Filter to one scenario (omit for all)

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show a campaign's items and progress rollups

commands.name: next
commands.description: Show the profile-ranked worklist of open items (fast = cheapest path to green; balanced = legacy regressions→cycles→severity; long-term = structural root-causes first)

flags.name: profile
flags.description: Ranking profile: fast | balanced (default) | long-term

commands.name: resolve
commands.description: Mark an item resolved with an operator note (the agent fixed it by hand)

flags.name: stable_id
flags.description: Finding stable id (afid:...)

flags.name: note
flags.description: Operator note (recommended)

commands.name: apply
commands.description: Record an item fix as a status-only transition (auto-execution stays deferred to the apply-execution plan)

flags.name: stable_id
flags.description: Finding stable id (afid:...)

commands.name: reaudit
commands.description: Reconcile a fresh audit against the tracked items: absent→validated, present→stay, (re)appeared→regression

flags.name: from-audit
flags.description: Path to a fresh test-genie --json SuiteExecutionResult (or - for stdin)

commands.name: close
commands.description: Close a campaign

groups.name: search

commands.name: query
commands.description: Search scenario domains by natural-language intent (e.g. "how does authoring work in plan-manager")

flags.name: limit
flags.description: Maximum number of results to return

flags.name: mode
flags.description: Force a retrieval mode: ai | text

commands.name: status
commands.description: Report domain-map search backend availability (ollama/qdrant reachability, indexed count)

flags.name: control-token

flags.name: control-token

commands.name: cancel

omitted.reason: Internal search-tuning write API consumed programmatically by the search-hub sweep (token-gated); no standalone operator CLI command.
Internal eval-corpus write API consumed programmatically by the search-hub optimizer (token-gated); no standalone operator CLI command.

Snapshots are intermediate state owned by the API; CLI consumers retrieve them via `graph extract <scenario>` which returns the snapshot inline. A standalone `graph get <id>` will land alongside the snapshot-history feature.
Snapshot history is an API-side audit surface; the CLI exposes only the freshest snapshot per scenario today. A `graph list <scenario>` command will land alongside snapshot-history UX.
Cache invalidation is administrative; will be exposed via an explicit admin-only subcommand once governance metadata for destructive cache ops is finalized.
Export is a tooling-side concern (fixture authoring, offline analysis); will land alongside the fixture-validator surface.
Shared cross-scenario validation surface; exercised via the audit run command rather than a dedicated binding.
Shared validation fix-preview surface; architecture-cartographer exposes remediation through audit/apply workflows rather than a dedicated shared-validation CLI binding.
Shared validation fix-application surface; architecture-cartographer keeps mutations behind its apply domain until governance for shared validation mutations is finalized.
